subject: world_language
concept: Negotiating and resolving a disagreement diplomatically in a professional context, in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences diplomatic negotiation-phrase cards into a coherent conflict-resolution exchange
exercise.abstract: Student performs a diplomatic negotiation exchange resolving a professional disagreement in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: exchange uses genuinely diplomatic language and reaches a reasonable resolution
misconception_flags: uses confrontational or overly blunt language inappropriate to a diplomatic professional negotiation

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
